An '''untitled [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] novel''' was supposed to be written by [[Karen Traviss]]<ref name="RH Q&A" /> for release in [[2011]].<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|eeusuestornii|11|A bit about the new novels.....}}</ref> It was to be set after the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' series and to contain some flashbacks into Boba Fett's past.<ref name="SWAN" /> However, after Traviss's unforeseen departure from ''[[Star Wars]]'' after ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'',<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://karentraviss.typepad.com/blog/2009/12/sooty-and-a-clean-sweep.html|text=Sooty and a clean sweep|author=Traviss, Karen|date=2009-12-02|work=karentraviss.typepad.com|archivedate=20091227202644}}</ref> the book was canceled.<ref name="SWBoards">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=9480|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|nobackup=1}}</ref> Traviss later stated in an interview that the reason the Boba Fett book was canceled was because of an issue involving the [[Star Wars: Underworld|unproduced ''Star Wars'' live-action TV series]].<ref>{{WebCite|url=https://io9.gizmodo.com/is-it-too-late-to-save-the-imperial-commandos-5466313|text=Is It Too Late To Save The Imperial Commandos?|author=Anders, Charlie Jane|date=2010-12-02|work=[[Wikipedia:Gizmodo|Gizmodo]]|archivedate=20200603012620}}</ref>

On [[August 24]], [[2017]], however, Traviss revealed in her Twitter account that she never pitched any exact story for the novel and that the cancellation happened before she could ever write a draft for the book's story.<ref name="Karen Tarviss tweet">{{Twitter|karentraviss|status/912025071744684032|[[Karen Traviss]]|quote=No idea. Didn't get that far.|nobackup=1}}</ref>
